fusions.name: Casting Mesh
fusions.desc: Throws a spread of links in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Draw Taut
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Deals 9 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of that.

fusions.name: Snare Line
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to lay a snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 40 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 14 damage in a blast 2.75 tiles across.

fusions.name: Tightening Mesh
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 5 damage, then to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 8 seconds.
